data.long_meaning: Mohibul is a Hindu name derived from the Sanskrit word ‘mohit’, which means ‘to enchant’. The name signifies being beloved by all, as if one is under the spell of love from everyone. It is a powerful name that symbolizes charm, allure, and popularity. The name Mohibul carries the meaning “Beloved by All” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Mohibul usually hope their child will grow to embody beloved by all and live with faith, good character and purpose.
